What's against it: the last 15 minutes show net outflow of -2.93 SOL, with sellers (288) nearly matching buyers (310), and a sell-to-buy ratio near 1 right after graduation. A $20 ticket against a 1.4-5.1% round trip cost would need a bounce that the flow data doesn't show. Demand is fading, not holding.

My recommendation is to skip. There is no case that real demand is here and will persist for the next 30-60 minutes.

The 47.9% drawdown from the 30-minute high means the early pump has largely round-tripped.
